title: 3dROIMaker
description: Create a labelled set of ROIs from input data, useful in combining functional and tractographic/structural data.

inset.description: 3D volume(s) of values, especially functionally-derived quantities like correlation values or ICA Z-scores.
inset.title: Input dataset

thresh.description: Threshold for values in INSET, used to create ROI islands from the 3D volume's sea of values.
thresh.title: Threshold value

prefix.description: Prefix of output name, with output files being: PREFIX_GM* and PREFIX_GMI*
prefix.title: Output prefix

refset.description: 3D (or multi-subbrick) volume containing integer values with which to label specific GM ROIs after thresholding.
refset.title: Reference dataset

volthr.description: Minimum size a cluster of voxels must have in order to remain a GM ROI after thresholding. Can reduce 'noisy' clusters.
volthr.title: Volume threshold

only_some_top.description: Restrict each found region to keep only N voxels with the highest inset values.
only_some_top.title: Keep top N voxels

only_conn_top.description: Select N max contiguous voxels in a region starting from peak voxel and expanding.
only_conn_top.title: Keep top N contiguous voxels

inflate.description: Number of voxels to pad each found ROI in order to turn GM ROIs into inflated (GMI) ROIs.
inflate.title: Inflation size

trim_off_wm.description: Trim the INSET to exclude voxels in WM by excluding those which overlap an input WM skeleton.
trim_off_wm.title: Trim off WM

wm_skel.description: 3D volume containing info of WM, as might be defined from an FA map or anatomical segmentation.
wm_skel.title: WM skeleton

skel_thr.description: Threshold value for WM skeleton if it is not a mask.
skel_thr.title: Skeleton threshold

skel_stop.description: Stop inflation at locations which are already on WM skeleton.
skel_stop.title: Stop at WM skeleton

skel_stop_strict.description: Do not allow any inflation into the skel-region.
skel_stop_strict.title: Strictly stop at WM skeleton

csf_skel.description: 3D volume containing info of CSF. Info must be a binary mask already.
csf_skel.title: CSF skeleton

mask.description: Mask within which to apply threshold. Useful if the MINTHR is a negative value.
mask.title: Input mask

neigh_upto_vert.description: Define neighbors loosely so that voxels can be grouped into the same ROI if they share at least one vertex.
neigh_upto_vert.title: Vertex neighbor grouping

nifti.description: Switch to output *.nii.gz GM and GMI files
nifti.title: Output NIFTI files

preinfl_inset.description: Start with a WM ROI, inflate it to find the nearest GM, then expand that GM and subtract away the WM+CSF parts.
preinfl_inset.title: Pre-inflation inset

preinfl_inflate.description: Number of voxels for initial inflation of PSET.
preinfl_inflate.title: Pre-inflation size

dump_no_labtab.description: Switch for turning off labeltable attachment to the output GM and GMI files.
dump_no_labtab.title: Disable labeltable
